patthana14.18:1.1: Āsavavippayuttaṃ sāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavavippayutto naanāsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (1)
patthana14.18:2.1: Āsavavippayuttaṃ anāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavavippayutto naanāsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… tīṇi.
patthana14.18:3.1: Āsavavippayuttaṃ sāsavañca āsavavippayuttaṃ anāsavañca dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavavippayutto nanoanāsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (1)
